In this competition it is not specified what is the maximum session time on rtx 6000 pro can we run session for 20 hour straight?

[message_id=3430834 author=TwangyGarlic449 first=False]
In this competition, the submission is a .zip file containing a Lora adapter. This is run by a script made by the hosts, not by the submitter. Thus, there is no use in imposing a run time limit.
Training runs used to create this Lora adapter may run for as long as you wish (although scripts run on Kaggle are limited to 12 hours; that's just how the platform is).
Hopefully this helps!

[message_id=3430923 author=Adarsh Kumar first=False]
Thank you
